ns2:section.sectionText: Registration is restricted to Human Nutrition and Dietetics seniors and FSHN and DNS graduate students only until after senior registration. Remaining seats will be made available to Human Nutrition and Dietetics juniors at the end of senior registration. All other interested students should e-mail Dr. Manabu Nakamura (mtnakamu@illinois.edu) for permission to register for the class. TO BE ADDED TO A WAIT LIST FOR THIS CLASS, go to www.fshn.uiuc.edu and click on "Info for Current Students" and then on "Waitlist Information."
